chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Sludge Spinner, then Coral Guard, dealing 9 damage and gaining 5 Block against the incoming 8 damage.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing All Streams Flow to the Sea followed by Water's Edge for 15 total damage, accepting the full 8-damage attack.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 6 immediate damage compared with the two-attack line and still allowed 3 damage through.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If the enemy had not intended to attack, I would have played All Streams Flow to the Sea and Water's Edge for maximum immediate damage.
